caption: The drawing depicts two earthenware vessels, both rendered in shades of reddish-brown with slightly darker and lighter variations to suggest light and shadow. The vessel on the left is squat and rounded with a wide opening and a single handle attached to one side, showing visible ridges at the rim. The vessel on the right is taller and more elongated, also featuring a prominent handle and a lip that juts outward at the top. Both vessels have visible texture and shading that indicates their three-dimensional form and thickness of the material. The background is a plain, light beige color with no visible decoration or pattern. The artist's signature, "Ralph Russell," is written in small letters toward the bottom right of the image.
title: Zoar Milk Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
